trust_center.accessRequestInstructions:
# Reviewing RegScale in the Trust Center Auditor Hub

For FedRAMP, agencies, and independent assessors who need to review RegScale's package. RegScale gives you access by email invitation. Everything RegScale has recorded is in the Auditor Hub: all 46 KSIs, all 157 FedRAMP rules, the evidence files, the independent assessor's determinations, the Security Decision Record (SDR) and this Certification Package Overview (CPO). To request an invitation or get help, email the Security contact listed in this CPO. Updated November 19, 2026.

## Before you start

- Use Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a computer.
- Open the invitation link in a private window (Ctrl+Shift+N). If you are already signed in to the Trust Center in your normal window, the link can land on the wrong page.

## Step 1. Accept your invitation

- Find the email with the subject "You're invited to join A-LIGN on Trust Center", sent from trustcenter@regscale.com to your work email address. It says you have been invited to join A-LIGN as an Auditor. A-LIGN is the independent assessor of RegScale's package; your invitation gives you access to the same audit.
- Click Accept Invitation. The link works for 7 days. If it has expired, ask the Security contact for a new invitation.
- On the page "Accept your invitation", type a new username (3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, underscores and dashes). Usernames are unique across the whole Trust Center, so if you already have a Trust Center account, choose a username different from it. Then type a password, type it again in Confirm password, and click Create account.

## Step 2. Sign in

- Go to https://trust.regscale.com/auth/login. In the box labeled Email, type the username you just made. Type your password and click Login.
- After you sign in you will see a banner, "Passkey required soon". Click Account in the left menu, type a name in the Passkey name box, and click Add a passkey. Follow your browser's prompt (security key, phone, fingerprint or device PIN). Your passkey then appears in the Passkeys list. You have 7 days from creating your account to add a passkey, and then sign-in requires it.
- After you have a passkey, sign in with your username and password and then use your passkey when the page says "Use your passkey to finish signing in". You can also click Sign in with a passkey on the login page.

## Step 3. Open RegScale's audit

- In the left menu click Engagements. Under Active engagements, find regscale and click Open workspace.
- If you see "No active engagements", your account has not been assigned to the engagement yet. Email the Security contact.

## Step 4. See all of RegScale's data

On the regscale engagement page you will see the audit totals: 203 of 203 items audited (46 KSIs and 157 FedRAMP rules). Use the tabs under them:

- KSI Worksheet (46) and FedRAMP Rules (157): one row per item. Click the Audit button on a row to open it. You will see what RegScale provided (its implementation narrative and its validation history), RegScale's evidence files (click Preview to open each file), and the assessor's determination and written conclusion.
- SDR Review: the Security Decision Record, in a readable view and as the machine-readable JSON.
- CPO Review: this Certification Package Overview.

Please view only. The assessor's determinations are the official record of the independent assessment, so please do not change them.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Continuous Controls Monitoring core (controls, assessments, POA and M, evidence)

certified.useCase: Source control and CI/CD: code repositories and GitHub Actions pipelines (deploy-gcp-v2.yml, trunk-pr.yml) that build, test, and deploy the offering.
Primary cloud hosting for the RegScale service offering: Cloud Run compute, managed PostgreSQL (Cloud SQL) and Redis (Memorystore), Cloud Storage buckets, VPC networking, and Secret Manager.
Cloud security posture management (CSPM) and vulnerability scanning across the GCP boundary; findings feed RegScale continuous monitoring.

current.service_desc: The RegScale Trust Center is an automated Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) offering built for FedRAMP 20x and CR26. It delivers continuous controls monitoring and publishes a FedRAMP-compatible trust center that meets every FedRAMP 20x provider rule, generating schema-valid, machine-readable evidence directly from live security posture and republishing automatically on change.
